priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore removal of the registered message listener
findings.body: Calling the function returned by attach no longer unregisters handler. The callback therefore continues receiving messages after cleanup and repeated attach-cleanup cycles accumulate listeners, causing stale or duplicate processing and memory retention.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 returns a no-op disposer immediately after line 2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler). The full diff shows this PR replaced the prior socket.off("message", handler) cleanup, so invoking the returned function leaves the callback active; repeated attach/dispose cycles cause stale or duplicate message handling and retain handlers.
